## Summary

Describe the change and the scientific or engineering question it addresses.

## Scope

- [ ] Documentation/presentation only
- [ ] Code with no scientific-output change
- [ ] Derived analysis from frozen inputs
- [ ] New experiment or claim-bearing evidence

## Evidence contract

For claim-bearing changes, list:

- frozen protocol or preregistration:
- input manifests and checksums:
- selection/design, certification, and evaluation roles:
- inference unit and confidence procedure:
- generated outputs:
- claim boundary or stop rule:

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass
- [ ] Input/output checksums were verified
- [ ] No evaluation role influenced selection or tuning
- [ ] Negative results, fallbacks, and censored cases are retained
- [ ] Documentation and claim-to-source mapping are updated
- [ ] No datasets, indexes, credentials, private paths, or large generated files were added

## Compatibility

Note any changes to public commands, configuration schemas, file formats, package imports, or historical replay paths.
